strings.ACCESS_EMPTY: No receipt has been written yet.
strings.ACCESS_EMPTY_BODY: An unlock, a reveal or a fill writes one · nothing here is a record of what you looked at until you look at something.
strings.ACCESS_ENTRIES_META: newest first, and a refusal is listed like an allowance
strings.ACCESS_LEDE: Every authentication and every reveal, with the page origin where there was one
strings.ACCESS_NO_VALUES: A receipt has never carried a value · these rows name the act, the item and the columns, and nothing else.
strings.ACCESS_OFFLINE: The gateway is out of reach · receipts live in the journal, which this device does not carry, and a cached history would be a list of what this device happened to hold
strings.ACCESS_WHERE: Needs you shows the same receipts, across every app.
strings.ADDRESSES_META: the primary first, each with its match policy
strings.ADDRESSES_NOTE: Every address this login answers to, each with its own match policy · the primary stays first.
strings.ADDRESSES_REPLACE_NOTE: Saving replaces the whole list, so a row removed here is removed in the vault.
strings.ALIAS_NOTE: A stable name an automation holds, so rotating the secret does not break it. Empty the field to clear it; type another to reassign it.
strings.ARCHIVE_META: kept forever, and out of the default window
strings.ARCHIVE_NOT_TRASH: Nothing here has a purge date · archive and trash are opposite ends of the same axis.
strings.ARCHIVE_NOTE: Kept forever, out of the lists · not a trash, so nothing is scheduled to be purged.
strings.ARCHIVED: Archived · kept, and out of the lists
strings.ATTACHMENTS_META: what the file is, and how big
strings.ATTACHMENTS_NOTE: These ride the vault file itself rather than the reveal gate · opening one costs no permit and writes no receipt.
strings.COMPROMISED_WHY: Flagged by hand or by an import; nothing sets it automatically, because breach checking would mean network egress.
strings.CONFLICT_COMPARE_BODY: Two versions · keep one; the secret values are compared without being shown
strings.CONFLICT_NOTICE: This item was edited here and on another device.
strings.CUSTOM_LABEL_MISSING: A label first — a field with none is a value nobody can find again.
strings.CUSTOM_NOTE: Text, sealed, address, date or a one-time code, grouped into sections · one field per act.
strings.DAY_ONE_BODY: Bring a password manager's file in, or put one login in by hand.
strings.DENIED_BODY: Every item, every receipt and every secret is untouched, and nothing was deleted.
strings.DUPLICATE_NOTE: Clone-and-edit for a sibling account · the sealed values are copied inside the vault, and the alias is not carried over.
strings.DUPLICATED: Duplicated · the copy is titled the same, and “copy”
strings.EDIT_CREATED: Item created · straight to the vault
strings.EDIT_FOOT: Saved to the vault directly · nothing about it is queued
strings.EDIT_FOOT_OFFLINE: The gateway is out of reach · a secret write waits for it rather than queueing
strings.EDIT_LEDE: Creating and editing a secret is online only, by design: no secret value ever enters the durable offline queue.
strings.EDIT_LEDE_TAIL: Everything else here — the star, the tags, the trash — works offline.
strings.EDIT_SAVED: Saved · straight to the vault, nothing queued
strings.EDIT_TITLE_MISSING: A title first — the list is titles.
strings.EXPORT_COMMIT_NOTE: A sovereign vault must let you leave · the confirm names the consequence, and the file is written on this device.
strings.EXPORT_CONFIRM_TITLE: Write every secret to a file?
strings.EXPORT_FORMAT_NOTE: So the file lands somewhere else without a converter.
strings.EXPORT_LEDE: This writes every title, username, address, note and password to a plaintext file on this device. Anything that reads the file reads your secrets.
strings.EXPORT_LEDE_TAIL: There is no encrypted export today.
strings.EXPORT_NOTHING: Nothing came back · no file was written.
strings.EXPORT_OFFLINE: The gateway is out of reach · an export is a mass reveal, and it is never answered from a device’s durable store
strings.EXPORT_OPTIONS_NOTE: Both are off unless you ask · every previous password is another secret in the file.
strings.EXPORT_PARKED: Parked · a mass reveal asked for on a device that is not the owner’s waits for them
strings.EXPORT_WHERE_NOTE: Written locally — what happens to it afterwards is outside the vault.
strings.EXPORT_WHERE_VALUE: This device only · it is never sent anywhere
strings.EXPORT_WRITTEN: Written · every secret is in that file now
strings.FIELD_SAVED: Field saved · straight to the vault
strings.FIELDS_META: the item's own sections, as the vault sorted them
strings.FILL_GET: Install the Companion extension on this browser; it asks this vault for candidates and nothing else.
strings.FILL_LEDE: Origin-matched candidates for the page in front of you · https only, and secret-free until the fill
strings.FILL_NOT_OFFERED_META: why a credential you have did not appear
strings.FILL_OFFERS: The logins whose address matches the page, one fill per gesture, and a receipt carrying that page origin.
strings.FILL_WHERE: In the browser extension, beside the page · never inside this app, which is why this screen offers no candidates
strings.GEN_NOTE: Look-alike characters are excluded always, so a password read off a screen and typed on a keypad is the same password.
strings.GEN_NOTHING_SAVED: Nothing is written until you put it on an item.
strings.GEN_PIN_STRENGTH: A PIN is short by definition · for a lock that only takes digits
strings.GEN_SEEDED: On the form · nothing is written until the item is saved
strings.HISTORY_PASSWORD_PRESENT: Previous password kept · sealed in this revision, and readable only through a confirmed export.
strings.IMPORT_DRAFTS_META: staged, and not in the vault
strings.IMPORT_FILE_NOTE: A password-manager CSV, parsed into a draft · nothing reaches the vault until the draft is published.
strings.IMPORT_LEDE: Draft, review, publish · nothing reaches the vault until the draft is published, and the vault wins every collision
strings.IMPORT_NO_DOOR: Import runs on the custodian — the desktop beside the gateway — and the draft is reviewed and published there.
strings.IMPORT_NO_ROWS: Nothing in that file was recognised · the draft holds no rows, and discarding it writes nothing.
strings.IMPORT_OFFLINE: The gateway is out of reach · an import carries the file itself, secrets and all, so it waits for a connection rather than queueing
strings.IMPORT_OTHER_ENTITY: not a Locker item · it lands in the app that owns it
strings.IMPORT_PUBLISH_NOTE: One act, over the whole draft, and it needs the gateway · a draft discarded writes nothing at all
strings.IMPORT_ROWS_META: each with the verdict the vault gave it
strings.IMPORT_STAGED: Staged as a draft · nothing is in the vault yet
strings.ITEMS_STATUS: Titles, usernames and addresses are browsable · a secret is revealed per item, per gesture, and receipted
strings.LOCK_BODY: Unlock Locker here to read a secret; inactivity, hidden windows and a restart all end the session.
strings.LOCK_UNAVAILABLE_BODY: This device cannot open secrets. Titles, addresses and usernames are still here; the values need a device that holds this vault's key.
strings.MORE_FOOT: Acts and surfaces · the four places are in the band
strings.OFFLINE_NOTICE: Offline · stars, tags, trash and restore work. Creating or editing a secret needs the gateway.
strings.OFFLINE_WHY_BODY: A secret never enters the durable offline queue · that is the rule, not a limitation
strings.PARKED_NOTICE: A purge was asked for on a device that is not the owner's · it waits for you.
strings.PASSKEY_CLEARED: Passkey cleared · metadata and key together
strings.PASSKEY_KEY_HELD: Key material is stored beside this slot, sealed like any other secret.
strings.PASSKEY_KEY_NONE: No key material is stored · the slot is the metadata alone.
strings.PASSKEY_NOTE: Storage only · nothing here performs a WebAuthn ceremony. The key material is sealed like any other secret.
strings.PASSKEY_RP_MISSING: A relying party first — a passkey belongs to a site.
strings.PASSKEY_SAVED: Passkey saved · straight to the vault
strings.PASSWORD_AGE_NOTE: Counted from the day it was set · Review scores the same clock, so the two can never disagree.
strings.PERMIT_GATE_LIFE: This mints one permit for this field, good for about 30 seconds.
strings.PERMIT_GATE_RECEIPT: It writes a receipt with the time and this device.
strings.PLAIN_FIELD_NOTE: Metadata · it never needed a permit.
strings.PURGE_PARKED: Parked · it waits for the owner's confirmation
strings.PURGE_PARKED_BODY: Irreversible, and asked for on a device that is not the owner's, so it parks until the owner confirms it.
strings.REAUTH_NOTICE: The permit for this item expired · nothing is revealed.
strings.RESTORED_WHOLE: Restored · whole, with its star and its tags
strings.REVEAL_NO_DOOR: This device cannot open secrets — it does not hold this vault's key.
strings.REVIEW_ITEMS_META: the same rows as the list, with the verdict
strings.REVIEW_NOTHING_BODY: A verdict needs an item to be about, and there are none here.
strings.REVIEW_UNRUNNABLE_META: the honest half of a review surface
strings.SEALED_NOTE: Sealed at rest — revealing it mints a one-shot permit of 30 seconds and writes a receipt.
strings.SEALED_UNCHANGED: Left as it is · type here only to replace the stored secret
strings.SEARCH_MATCHED: matched the title, username or address
strings.SEARCH_NOTE: Secret values and notes are not searched — a note routinely holds recovery codes.
strings.TAGS_NOTE: Free-form, and the same vocabulary the rest of the superapp uses.
strings.TRASH_CONFIRM_BODY: Thirty days, with its star and its tags, so a restore brings it back whole.
strings.TRASH_META: star and tags kept, so a restore is lossless
strings.TYPE_NOTE: Fifteen exist · one the vault does not have yet degrades to a note with custom fields rather than to nothing.
strings.VIEWER_REFUSED: A shared browser cannot hold the user-presence boundary this app depends on, so Locker refuses the seat outright.
strings.WINDOW_RULE: the window is 300 by default and 2,000 at most.
